summary: Full backend + frontend regression testing of SIPOSTLOG completed. 32/32 pytest tests passed covering health, public leak-check, auth/me, RBAC (admin/petugas/pending), IN/OUT/ADJUST transactions, dashboards, filters, all 4 Excel exports, Excel template + import round-trip, admin user management (invalid role, self-demote, role toggle), and item minThreshold PATCH. Frontend UI verified via Playwright with seeded session cookies: public page renders 33 items with no stock leak, admin sees all 8 sidebar menus and can navigate every internal page, petugas has 'Kelola Pengguna' hidden and is redirected from /app/pengguna to /app/stok, pending token redirects to /menunggu, Google login button present on /login. Stock-in form submission succeeds and shows transaction-result card; Catat Penyaluran with excess quantity shows 'Stok tidak mencukupi' error; Excel page shows 4 download buttons (Stok, Penyaluran, Riwayat, Template); Kelola Pengguna page lists 3 users with role selects and Nonaktifkan buttons.

issues: DOM appears to render each item twice (66 card nodes for 33 items) — likely intentional desktop+mobile responsive duplication using hidden classes; no functional/visual bug observed but worth confirming there is no wasted rendering.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~570 lines and mixes helpers, models, routes, startup — consider splitting into routers/models/services if it grows further, but currently acceptable.

excel_import: `apply_adjustment` is invoked inside a loop without a transaction; a mid-loop DB failure would leave partial updates. Consider wrapping in a MongoDB session/transaction or documenting best-effort behavior.
dashboard_stock computes stock_status(i) three times per item (categories loop, status_counts dict-comp, items map) — minor micro-optimisation opportunity.
public/items response `text` is checked in tests for leaked strings; server code correctly whitelists returned fields via explicit dict — good.
PATCH /users/{id} self-guard uses `update.get('role', ROLE_ADMIN) != ROLE_ADMIN`; the default ROLE_ADMIN is intentional so an active-only toggle doesn't false-trigger. Verified correct via tests.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests appended 2 IN transactions and 2 OUT transactions and a couple of ADJUSTMENT transactions on item-001 (highest-stock). Net stock delta on item-001: +12. Frontend stock-in test additionally +5. Seeded test users/sessions untouched (pending role restored, session re-upserted after transient patch).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses Bearer tokens from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Runs in ~4s. All endpoints healthy. When re-running, be aware the suite mutates item-001 stock and creates TEST_ transactions (harmless). Public leak check enforces no currentStock/minThreshold anywhere in payload. Frontend uses shadcn selects backed by native <select> elements — use select_option() on the first <select> for the item picker on stock-in/penyaluran/koreksi pages.
